title: Three types of destination number
body_md:
Destination numbers are the telephone numbers to be notified in the event of an alarm. Up to ten numbers can be stored. The source distinguishes three types:

| Type | Meaning according to the source |
| --- | --- |
| Master number | The number that comes first when the destination numbers are saved. It can be used to programme new destination numbers at any time without accessing the operating mode switch. |
| Authorised numbers | May control the outputs of Pro-finder by text message and request status reports. |
| Unauthorised numbers | Have no access to the functions of the system and receive status messages only. |

How the device assigns a number to one of these types is not stated at this point.
